description: Control running and enabled state for system-wide or user services.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Enable or disable the service, independently of *.preset file preference or running state. Mutually exclusive with preset. It takes effect prior to state=reset. Choices: false true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the service to manage.

parameters.name: preset
parameters.description: Enable or disable the service according to local preferences in *.preset files. Mutually exclusive with enabled. Only has an effect if set to true. It takes effect prior to state=reset. Choices: false true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: started/stopped are idempotent actions that do not run commands unless necessary. restarted always bounces the service. reloaded sends a SIGHUP or starts the service. reset starts or stops the service according to whether it is enabled or not. Choices: "started" "stopped" "reset" "restarted" "reloaded"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Run system-control talking to the calling user’s service manager, rather than the system-wide service manager. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Start dnscache if not running
  community.general.nosh:
    name: dnscache
    state: started

- name: Stop mpd, if running
  community.general.nosh:
    name: mpd
    state: stopped

- name: Restart unbound or start it if not already running
  community.general.nosh:
    name: unbound
    state: restarted

- name: Reload fail2ban or start it if not already running
  community.general.nosh:
    name: fail2ban
    state: reloaded

- name: Disable nsd
  community.general.nosh:
    name: nsd
    enabled: false

- name: For package installers, set nginx running state according to local enable settings, preset and reset
  community.general.nosh:
    name: nginx
    preset: true
    state: reset

- name: Reboot the host if nosh is the system manager, would need a "wait_for*" task at least, not recommended as-is
  community.general.nosh:
    name: reboot
    state: started

- name: Using conditionals with the module facts
  tasks:
    - name: Obtain information on tinydns service
      community.general.nosh:
        name: tinydns
      register: result

    - name: Fail if service not loaded
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "The {{ result.name }} service is not loaded"
      when: not result.status

    - name: Fail if service is running
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "The {{ result.name }} service is running"
      when: result.status and result.status['DaemontoolsEncoreState'] == "running"

return_values.name: enabled
return_values.description: Whether the service is enabled at system bootstrap. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name used to find the service. Returned: success Sample: "sshd"

return_values.name: preset
return_values.description: Whether the enabled status reflects the one set in the relevant *.preset file. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: service_path
return_values.description: Resolved path for the service. Returned: success Sample: "/var/sv/sshd"

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: Service process run state, none if the service is not loaded and will not be started. Returned: if state option is used Sample: "reloaded"

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: A dictionary with the key=value pairs returned by system-control show-json or none if the service is not loaded. Returned: success

return_values.name: user
return_values.description: Whether the user-level service manager is called. Returned: success Sample: false
